topic_title: Yielding to Emergency Vehicles, School Buses & Pedestrians
prompt: When approaching a pedestrian carrying a white cane or accompanied by a service animal at a crossing, what is required?

options.text: Sound your horn lightly to notify the pedestrian of your vehicle location
Come to a complete stop and take all necessary precautions to avoid injury
Proceed at five miles per hour as long as you do not touch the cane
Yield only if an official pedestrian walk signal is actively illuminated
